name: Moonlit Blessed
source:
Moonlit Blessed is a game made in RPG Maker VX Ace for the RPG Maker 2025 Game Jam, with the theme "beyond expectations".
Accompany your best friend on a quest to bring the Moon back to the sky.

[From [url=https://quiesphere.itch.io/moonlit-blessed]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Moonlit Blessed是一款在RPG Maker VX Ace中为RPG Maker 2025 Game Jam制作的游戏，主题为“超越预期”。
和你最好的朋友一起踏上将月亮带回天空的旅程。

[来自[url=https://quiesphere.itch.io/moonlit-blessed]Itch.io[/url]]
